Same-run H35 pooled DTI drifted 0.14796–0.14989 across the three experiments (IR-25-COMPARATOR-DRIFT); gates use same-run controls only.
Prompt live claims 0.3195 / 0.4413 remain unverified; DrivenData was not contacted. Group-best 0.2778 is OWNER-REPORTED.
Template, labels, and top-scorer rasters are owner mirrors pinned by SHA-256, not organizer-authenticated (IR-25-PROVENANCE).
